Hurricane Polo Intensifies Rapidly Due to El Niño

Hurricane Polo, located off the Mexican coast, has experienced explosive growth and is described as one of the strongest storms ever in its region. The intensification of Hurricane Polo is attributed to the El Niño weather pattern, which can fuel storms in certain areas while suppressing them in others.
